biography.value:
Human, female, 35. This confident, uniformed figure is the captain of the local guard. She wears fine, gold ear cuffs. Amira has an easy, relaxed swagger, clearly comfortable with both her environment and the weapons strung at her hip.

She is not charmed. Amira works with Selyse willingly — she earns a decent salary in the town guard but has always dreamed of a grander lifestyle, and Selyse promised her a share of the riches without ever using magic on her. She keeps the lamia hidden and feeds her new followers, and has already marked the party as viable candidates.

Play her as a helpful ally right up to the hideout: she offers the party 75gp each to help clear it out, fights alongside them against the Giant Scorpion, and only turns when Selyse is exposed. Her purse holds exactly what she promised — the party can take it from her once she is defeated.

Stat block (SRD Spy)

Skills Deception +5, Insight +4, Investigation +5, Perception +6, Persuasion +5, Sleight of Hand +4, Stealth +4. Passive Perception 16. Languages any two.

Cunning Action. On each of her turns she can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

Sneak Attack (1/turn). Deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when she hits with a weapon attack and has advantage, or when the target is within 5 ft. of an ally and she does not have disadvantage.

Multiattack. Two melee attacks.

Shortsword. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

Hand Crossbow. +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.
